```artifact
Feature: System Backup and Reporting

  Scenario: System Backup
    Given the system is running
    When the backup process is triggered
    Then the backup files are created and rotated every 30 days
    And the backup files are sent to the remote site

  Scenario: User Authentication
    Given a user is registered with a username and password
    When the user logs in with their credentials
    Then the user is authenticated successfully

  Scenario: Doctor Wise Appointment Report
    Given the system has appointment data for the next 5 days
    When the doctor wise appointment report is generated
    Then the report shows the correct appointments for the next 5 days

  Scenario: Speciality Wise Consultation Report
    Given the system has consultation data for the last day of the month
    When the speciality wise consultation report is generated
    Then the report shows the correct consultations for the last day of the month

  Scenario: Speciality Wise Revenue Report
    Given the system has revenue data for the last day of the month
    When the speciality wise revenue report is generated
    Then the report shows the correct revenue for the last day of the month

  Scenario Outline: Password Change
    Given a user is logged in with their credentials
    When the user changes their password
    Then the password is updated successfully
    Examples:
      | user_type | old_password | new_password |
      | doctor    | password123  | password456  |
      | chemist   | password789  | password012  |
      | lab       | password345  | password678  |

  Scenario Outline: Report Period Boundary Tests
    Given the system has data for the last day of the month
    When the report is generated for the last day of the month
    Then the report shows the correct data
    Examples:
      | month | year |
      | 1     | 2022 |
      | 12    | 2022 |

  Scenario: Backup Rotation Logic
    Given the system has backup files for the last 30 days
    When the backup rotation process is triggered
    Then the oldest backup files are deleted and the new files are rotated

  Scenario: Backup Failure Error Handling
    Given the system is unable to send the backup files to the remote site
    When the backup process is triggered
    Then an error message is displayed and the backup files are not deleted
```
